name: Marion "O" Dangermeier
original_name: マリオン "O" ダンジェルマイア
source:
A cool girl who doesn't particularly seek out interaction with others.
She believes bringing emotion into battle is irrational, but gradually becomes influenced after meeting Yakumo.
She often finds herself being hugged by Yakumo, who exclaims, “You're so cute, like a doll!”

Possessed by the Divine Skeleton Princess Nahato, her personality becomes tsundere.
She seems to frequently disagree with Rachel on various matters.
